hazards.evidence: A loose, rumpled bath mat lies directly in the bathroom walking area in front of the sink.
The route into the bathroom is narrowed by a stool, shoes, pet bowls, a toy, and a loose mat, leaving limited walker maneuvering space.
The hallway and bathroom route are very dimly lit.
Pet bowls and a pet toy are on the floor in the walking path.
The inward-swinging doors substantially constrict the already narrow bathroom approach, potentially preventing safe walker passage.
